reasoning: On the season so far the Rockets are the stronger team; with home court the Rockets start about 3 points better, in a game of about 235 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Heat.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Rockets win 51 times in 100; most games like this end between 209 and 257 total points.

analyst.text: Both teams arrive on four-game winning streaks, and Miami's own preview calls Houston their 'toughest test to date'. Fred VanVleet is back from the torn ACL that cost him last season and says he is 'appreciating every minute', but the Rockets are coming off a game in Washington the night before. No locker-room or trade storylines were found; the angle is fairly neutral, with a slight lean to the rested home side.
